# `trace_context`

Propagates W3C Trace Context and `x-request-id` correlation.

## Configuration Notes

Per W3C Trace Context, multiple `traceparent` fields are invalid. `tracestate` is forwarded only with exactly one valid inbound `traceparent`, and only after member validation (Level 2 key grammar, unique keys, no empty list-members, at most 32 members).

Currently accepts no fields; reserved for future options such as trusted-header policies or sampling flag overrides.

## Example

```yaml
filter: trace_context
```
